I’m backing out that partial implementation while keeping the RED tests. The revised design is one declarative execution-edge grammar shared with `test_lane_governor`, plus one generic AST/argv resolver with three outcomes: proven Git, proven non-Git, or unresolved (reject). Wrapper option/operand layouts will be data, not conditional fallback code; exec/eval will recurse through the same resolver. No blanket exclusions or “best effort” paths.
